originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest prior work shows no anticipation of the specific threshold/extremal dataset. Braun et al. arXiv:2103.17156 classifies IDP for <=3 distinct non-unit weights and builds stabilizations with h* coefficients {1,2} non-unimodal — no h2<=3h1 bound, no Q<=377 threshold, no (6,14,21)-core family, violator (2,7,54,126,189) outside their family. Braun-Davis-Solus arXiv:1608.01614 proves IDP implies unimodality for Payne-generalization — no linear coefficient bound or volume threshold or minimal violator. Ghirlanda arXiv:2510.09131 gives general classification algorithm for dims 5-6 with Picard/Gorenstein formulae — backdrop machinery, no coefficient inequality or extremal table. Bayer et al. arXiv:2005.09628 concerns Schur/Grothendieck Newton polytopes — different objects. Direct arXiv search for h2*/reflexive-simplex threshold returned no match. Internal Resultary/FAIL scan (20+20 records) concerns different dimensions/objects. The combination — sharp Q=377/378 cutoff, equality classification at h*=(1,2,6,2,1), first violator h*=(1,75,226,75,1), and finite 14-member (u,v,6m,14m,21m) fractional-part explanation — appears nowhere in checked sources. Not a timestamp argument: based on content comparison.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a sharp, reproducible extremal dataset, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, epsilon gain, or unexplained enumeration. (1) Precise new phenomenon: unconditional linear bound h2*<=3h1* valid to exactly Q=377 with complete equality classification, and exact breakdown point Q=378 with named minimal violator — a volume threshold where clean inequality first fails. (2) Structural explanation beyond brute force: closed fractional-part age decomposition for 14-member (6,14,21)-core family showing 8 violators with excess growing -23 to +64, identifying mechanism (periodic {k/7}+{k/3}+{k/2} mass). (3) Motivation grounded in Ehrhart positivity/unimodality for reflexive/Gorenstein polytopes, Hibi-type inequalities, and Braun-Davis-Solus IDP-unimodality program; timely given Kreuzer-Skarke and dims 5-6 classifications. (4) Reproducibility: stdlib-only <60-line sweep (~1 min) plus independent gauge-fixed Ehrhart recount with no shared code path, archived table and scripts rerunnable <30 min. Explicitly scoped to weighted-projective 4-simplices with honest computational-proof limitation. Meets bar for note/data theorem.
